race.description: Rjc Family Fun Day Dec 6 Mdn Hcp
race.comment: GATHERS NO STONE (1) finds the maiden win elusive but it certainly hasn't been without trying. Only missed by a lip here when resuming and now gets Wiggo taking over. Won't get too many better chances to get off the mark than this. URBAN REALITY (2) was no match for a dominant winner on debut here back in August but still did a good job to manage the rest. Has trialled well in readiness and can make a bright return. MARGERY (7) chased gamely into the placings on debut here last month. Is sure to have come on from that and gets weight relief with the 2kg claimer engaged. Can play a major role from the inside draw. TIAKI (4) as been hardly inspiring to date but appears best of the rest.
